verdict.rationale: Vanta publishes a well-documented public REST API (Manage Vanta API, Auditor API) with endpoints for tests, documents, policies, evidence, IRLs, webhooks, and official SDKs, plus probe evidence confirms the docs hub is live and structured (llms.txt) for programmatic/agentic consumption. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s at standard locations) and independent third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs.
